description: Plan, build and publish websites on Simple Host (simple-host.app) from a conversation: business sites, product and launch pages, client portals and tools, with saved data, visitor sign-in, your own domain and visitor analytics.

interface.longDescription:
Tell ChatGPT the website you want, for example a salon site with a booking form, a product page with a waitlist, or a client portal, and Simple Host puts it online at its own address that you can share straight away.

Sites can save data: tables, key-value data and files, 10 MB each per site. You pick who can read and add for each one, using presets such as inbox (anyone adds, only you read), records (each signed-in visitor sees only their own), or public. Visitors sign in on your site with Google or an email code, so "each client sees only their own" works without any code.

Change a site any time by asking for it. The four latest versions are kept, so you can preview one or put it back, and a deleted site can be restored for 7 days.

Ask how many people visited, which pages they read and where they came from. Give a site a free name.simple-host.app address or connect your own domain with HTTPS, lock a site with a passcode or open it only to people you name, and download a copy of any site whenever you like.

Sign in once and ChatGPT remembers you in every chat after that. Simple Host is free and MIT open source, made and run by Vineet Sriram.
capabilities: Publish websites, each at its own public address
Edit, rename, preview, roll back and delete your sites
Save bookings, quote requests, waitlists and orders
Choose who can read and add saved data, with simple presets
Let visitors sign in so each person sees only their own records
Lock a site with a passcode or open it only to named people
Connect your own domain or a free simple-host.app address
See visitors, top pages and where they came from
Download a copy of any site
defaultPrompt: Build a small shop for my spice pantry with an order form, and keep the orders private so only I can read them
Make a site for my home cleaning business with a booking form, then show me who has booked
Create a sign-up page for a local families resource hub, and tell me how many people visited this week

publication.release_notes: New websites use KV, SQLite and file resources, visitor sign-in on the site's own address, and each person's own records. The connector no longer offers the older state, collection and declared-data tools; those routes keep working for existing sites only, maintained directly with the owner's API key. A new get_page_recipe tool returns exact page code for records and forms. Simple Hack websites use only KV, SQLite and files.
